import torch
L='model.language_model.'
E=W(L+'embed_tokens.weight')
ids=torch.load('/work/ids.pt')
mu=E[:200000].mean(0)
dirs={}
for k,v in ids.items():
    d=E[v].mean(0)-mu; dirs[k]=d/d.norm()
D=torch.stack(list(dirs.values()))
torch.save(dirs,'/work/dirs.pt')
res={}
for l in range(30):
    dw=W(L+f'layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight')*W(L+f'layers.{l}.post_feedforward_layernorm_1.weight')[:,None]
    c=dw/dw.norm(dim=0,keepdim=True)
    cs=D@c  # sets x units
    line=[]
    for i,k in enumerate(dirs):
        v,ix=cs[i].abs().topk(2)
        line.append(f"{k}:{ix[0].item()}({cs[i,ix[0]].item():+.2f})")
    print(l,' '.join(line))
    res[l]=cs
torch.save(res,'/work/mlpcos.pt')
